## About
Bojan's Auto Body is a family owned collision repair business. John started the company as a mechanical shop and added collision repair shortly after. Around that time he moved to Dundee Rd in Northbrook, where the shop still is today.
Mike, Tom and Dan carried the business on after John retired, determined to continue our reputation for top quality work. Jonathan joined the family business as a collision repair technician. Most of our technicians have been with us long enough to remember working for John. We believe in hiring only the best and holding on to them.
Customer service and quality are our number one concern. Our customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 30 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body damage repair done with care, from the first look to handing back your keys.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: On Dundee Rd in Northbrook, where the shop still is today.

Q: Can you help with a rental car?
A: One customer said we called the Rent-A-Car company to pick them up and arranged for the rental to be returned when they picked up their car. Give us a call and ask.

Q: Who can I email?
A: You can reach Jonathan at Jonathan@bojansautobody.com or Tom at Tom@bojansautobody.com.
